title: Covariate-conditional reference change values for HbA1c derived from routine laboratory data: analysis code
description: Analysis code (Python 3.11) and the synthetic validation cohort supporting the article 'Covariate-conditional reference change values for HbA1c derived from routine laboratory data: type 2 diabetes with and without diabetic nephropathy' (submitted to Clinical Chemistry, 2026). The pipeline fits a location-scale Student-t density to log-differences of consecutive results to obtain phenotype-specific within-subject variation and asymmetric RCVs, and a hierarchical Student-t dispersion model (PyMC) to derive covariate-conditional RCVs. Patient data are not included; data/INPUT_SCHEMA.md describes the input layout so the pipeline can be applied to other laboratories' serial HbA1c data. See README.md.
